newsitem.title: USA: United Tech unit building design center.
newsitem.headline: United Tech unit building design center.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Thursday its UT Automotive Group had begun construction of a $3-million center aimed at sparking design innovation.

The 27,000-square-foot research facility is designed to stimulate creativity among auto product engineers by offering an open environment without walls or cubicles, said the company. Part of the so-called Idea Center will be dedicated to prototype construction, said UT Automotive.
UT Automotive supplies electrical, electronic and interior trim systems as well as components to manufacturers of cars and light trucks.
